passages.text: Results of Operations Non-GAAP Measures The following discussion includes organic sales, total segment operating earnings and margin, Adjusted Income, Adjusted EPS, Adjusted Effective Tax Rate, and free cash flow, which are non-GAAP measures. See Supplemental Sales Information for a reconciliation of reported sales to organic sales and a discussion of why we believe this non-GAAP measure is useful to investors. See Summary of Results of Operations for a reconciliation of Income before income taxes to total segment operating earnings and margin and a discussion of why we believe these non-GAAP measures are useful to investors. See Adjusted Income, Adjusted EPS, and Adjusted Effective Tax Rate Reconciliation for a reconciliation of Net income attributable to Rockwell Automation, diluted EPS, and effective tax rate to Adjusted Income, Adjusted EPS, and Adjusted Effective Tax Rate, respectively, and a discussion of why we believe these non-GAAP measures are useful to investors. See Financial Condition for a reconciliation of Cash provided by operating activities to free cash flow and a discussion of why we believe this non-GAAP measure is useful to investors. Overview Rockwell Automation, Inc. is the world’s largest company dedicated to industrial automation and digital transformation. Overall demand for our hardware and software products, solutions, and services is driven by: • investments in manufacturing, including new facilities or production lines, upgrades, modifications and expansions of existing facilities or production lines; • investments in basic materials production capacity, which may be related to commodity pricing levels; • our customers’ needs for faster time to market, agility to address evolving consumer preferences, operational productivity, asset management and reliability, and business resilience, including security and enterprise risk management; • our customers’ needs to continuously improve quality, safety, and sustainability; • industry factors that include our customers’ new product introductions, demand for our customers’ products or services, and the regulatory and competitive environments in which our customers operate; • levels of global industrial production and capacity utilization; • regional factors that include local political, social, regulatory, and economic circumstances; and • the spending patterns of our customers due to their annual budgeting processes and their working schedules. Long-term Strategy As the world’s largest company dedicated to industrial automation and digital transformation, our strategy is to bring the Connected Enterprise ® to life. We understand and simplify our customers’ complex production challenges and deliver the most valued solutions that combine technology and industry expertise. As a result, we make our customers more resilient, agile, and sustainable, creating more ways to win. We deliver value by helping our customers optimize production, build resilience, empower people, become more sustainable, and accelerate transformation. credit_strengths.text: Operating margin expanded year over year and sits modestly above the sector median, reflecting pricing power and mix in the automation and digital transformation franchise. This earnings quality underpins the modest indicative financial risk profile and gives headroom against the next leverage band.

Free cash flow comfortably covers dividends and buybacks combined, so shareholder returns are funded from internally generated cash rather than incremental borrowing. Operating cash flow also exceeds capital expenditure plus distributions, leaving residual liquidity for debt reduction or bolt-on investment.

key_risks.text: Demand is tied to customer capital spending, and the disclosed manufacturing PMI readings stayed below the expansion threshold through the fiscal fourth quarter, signalling contraction in served industrial markets. A prolonged softness in North American manufacturing investment would pressure orders and the earnings base that supports leverage headroom.

Gross leverage improved year over year and sits below the sector median, yet net leverage remains above the sector median because the cash buffer is comparatively thin. The debt stack combines long-term borrowings with a sizeable short-term borrowing component, so refinancing and rollover risk warrants monitoring.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage improved year over year and remains strong in absolute terms, though it sits marginally below the sector median. Operating income covers gross interest expense many times over, so a moderate earnings decline would not impair the ability to service scheduled interest.

Cash flow to debt strengthened sharply year over year, but remains below the sector median, and free cash flow to debt is likewise below peers. Coverage of net debt by operating cash flow clears the next risk-band boundary, indicating the cash-flow tier is the binding constraint on the indicative profile.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is modest, with leverage in the lowest tier and cash-flow coverage one tier higher. Leverage sits below the sector median and improved year over year, while net leverage remains above peers, so the balance sheet is solid but not peer-leading on a net basis.

Liquidity is adequate rather than ample: the current ratio improved year over year but trails the sector median, and cash holdings are modest relative to total debt. Our forward view is that distributions and working capital will absorb most free cash flow, leaving limited deleveraging unless industrial demand recovers.

credit_strengths.text: 營業利潤率按年擴大，並略高於行業中位數，反映自動化及數碼轉型業務的定價能力與產品組合。此盈利質素支撐溫和的指示性財務風險狀況，並為下一槓桿區間提供緩衝空間。
自由現金流足以覆蓋股息與回購的總和，因此股東回報由內部產生現金而非增量借貸提供資金。經營現金流亦超過資本開支加分派，留有剩餘流動性用於減債或補強式投資。

key_risks.text: 需求與客戶資本開支掛鈎，而披露的製造業PMI讀數於財政第四季度持續低於擴張門檻，顯示所服務的工業市場處於收縮。北美製造業投資若持續疲弱，將對訂單及支撐槓桿緩衝空間的盈利基礎構成壓力。
總槓桿按年改善並低於行業中位數，惟淨槓桿仍高於行業中位數，因現金緩衝相對薄弱。債務結構結合長期借款與相當規模的短期借款部分，故再融資及滾動風險值得監察。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率按年改善，絕對水平仍然強勁，惟略低於行業中位數。經營利潤覆蓋總利息開支多倍，故盈利適度下滑不會損害償付預定利息的能力。
現金流對債務比率按年大幅增強，但仍低於行業中位數，自由現金流對債務比率亦低於同業。經營現金流對淨債務的覆蓋率跨越下一風險區間界線，顯示現金流層級為指示性狀況的約束因素。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為溫和，槓桿處於最低層級，現金流覆蓋則高一層級。槓桿低於行業中位數並按年改善，惟淨槓桿仍高於同業，故資產負債表穩健，但按淨額基準並非領先同業。
流動性屬充足而非充裕：流動比率按年改善但落後於行業中位數，現金持有量相對總債務而言適度。我們的前瞻觀點是分派及營運資金將吸收大部分自由現金流，除非工業需求復甦，否則減債空間有限。
